description: H20 4xEP4 V12 comm/L2-regime sweep: measured palindromic ABBA (cuda event per launch, max over 4 ranks), every arm passed the randn FP32 full-tensor accuracy gate (calc_diff < 1e-3, cos > 0.999) before timing; pure 21-knob env audit on every public arm.
significance:
robust sigma = 1.4826 * MAD of the samples, SE(median) ~
1.2533 * sigma / sqrt(n); z = (arm - anchor) / sqrt(SE_arm^2 + SE_anchor^2).
verdict: "positive" if delta <= -1% and z <= -3; "marginal_positive" if delta < 0 and
z <= -2 but |delta| < 1% (below the ~1% batch-to-batch drift of an anchor, e.g. the
WEAVE_REG_BALANCE=1 arm at E/rank = 64, which changes no device code, lands here);
"negative" if delta >= 1% and z >= 3; otherwise "neutral".
